_comment: Ground truth for the mixed docs-qa task. `needle` items are exact-match (a planted ZK code). `open` items are judged by an LLM against `expect` (facts that MUST be present) and `reject` (a wrong answer signature). The agent never sees this file; the judge does. Questions are anchored in the real content of each document.

items.question: What is the single safety action the manual says to take before ANY troubleshooting or maintenance on the bath lighting, and what hazard does it prevent?
expect: disconnect / cut power to the bath lighting at the circuit breaker (disjoncteur) before intervening
the hazard is electric shock / electrocution (risque de choc électrique, possibly fatal)
items.reject: an answer that gives an unrelated step or omits the circuit breaker / power-off action

items.question: What problem does the academic paper address, and in which application domain?
expect: systematically characterizing a group of sequences by its common subsequences (of any length) / proposing a new algorithm for it
the application domain is Android malware detection / classification (from dynamic-analysis event sequences)
items.reject: a generic 'it is about sequences/data' answer with no mention of Android malware detection/classification

items.doc: pdf_large.pdf (Gecko in.xe troubleshooting guide, FR, long)
items.question: For error code FLO on the spa controller, give at least two of the concrete actions the guide recommends.
expect: wait about 2 minutes (attendez environ 2 minutes) / re-check the LED status after a delay
ensure the installation meets the minimum required water flow (débit d'eau minimum); possibly replace the heater (chauffe-eau) if the error is permanent
items.reject: an answer that invents actions not tied to water flow / waiting / heater, or that addresses a different error code

items.question: Describe the target customer persona in this document: gender, age range, and two of the sales sectors mentioned.
expect: generally a man (homme), aged roughly 25 to 45
at least two B2B sectors from: energy/green economy, IT, health, real estate, finance, agri-food (énergie, IT, santé, immobilier, finance, agro-alimentaire)
items.reject: wrong age range, or no real sectors from the document

items.question: What metaphor does the author use to explain why the 'Mojo' is elusive?
expect: the video-game designer / creator: because you built the game from A to Z and know every detail, you cannot enjoy playing it — knowing/being aware of the Mojo makes you lose it
items.reject: an answer that misses the game-designer metaphor or invents a different one

items.question: According to the guide, where should a user look FIRST for help?
expect: the Preferences dialog (la boîte de dialogue 'Préférences'), where every option has a clear description
items.reject: an answer pointing at a forum/website/other place instead of the Preferences dialog

items.doc: odp.odp (slide deck on GPT prompt chaining, FR)
items.question: What limitation of GPTs does this deck identify, and what solution does it propose?
expect: the limitation: once there are too many instructions, the GPT stops following them / a single prompt cannot express a long precise process
items.reject: an answer that names neither the too-many-instructions problem nor chained prompts

items.question: Across the whole document set, which single document is an academic research paper, and what is its subject?
expect: the academic paper is pdf_mid.pdf (Systematic Characterization of a Sequence Group)
subject: characterizing sequence groups by common subsequences, applied to Android malware detection/classification
items.reject: naming a manual/guide/persona document as the paper, or the wrong subject

items.question: Find the incident escalation code to quote on a severity-1 fault.
Find the field code given in the appendix.
